exercises.question: Complete the word for a pet: c_t.
exercises.solution: The short a sound completes the word c-t for this animal.

exercises.question: Complete: b_ok (something to read).
exercises.solution: The word for something to read uses the double-o pattern.

exercises.question: Choose the correct spelling: frend or friend.
exercises.solution: The correct spelling includes ie after fr.

exercises.question: Choose the correct spelling: skool or school.
exercises.solution: The word begins with the letter pattern sch.

exercises.question: Complete: I ___ a pencil. (have or hav)
exercises.solution: The verb have ends with a silent e.
